findings.message: The source-of-funds attestation is older than the freshness window.
findings.remediation: Refresh sponsor funding attestations before the challenge is opened or extended.

findings.message: The sponsor screening result requires compliance review.
findings.remediation: Hold publication until the screening review is resolved.

findings.message: The sanctions screening result is older than the allowed freshness window.
findings.remediation: Refresh the screening packet before accepting submissions or paying prize funds.

findings.message: The challenge has no export-control classification.
findings.remediation: Classify the challenge as exempt, EAR99, restricted, or not applicable before publication.

findings.message: International participation is expected but no participant-control digest is attached.
findings.remediation: Record eligibility controls for international participants before the challenge opens.

findings.message: The public terms do not identify cancellation and refund handling.
findings.remediation: Publish cancellation and refund language so sponsors and solvers share the same expectations.

findings.message: The challenge lacks a sponsor compliance escalation contact.
findings.remediation: Add a compliance contact for screening, tax, export-control, or sponsor-attestation questions.

findings.message: The sponsor has not supplied a verifiable source-of-funds attestation.
findings.remediation: Require a signed source-of-funds statement digest before accepting submissions.

findings.message: The sponsor packet contains an unresolved blocked sanctions screening result.
findings.remediation: Block the challenge until compliance counsel clears or rejects the sponsor.

findings.message: A beneficial owner has a screening hit without a resolution record.
findings.remediation: Attach a compliance resolution digest or block the challenge.

findings.message: A high-value prize lacks a tax reporting plan digest.
findings.remediation: Attach the sponsor-side tax reporting plan before submissions are opened.

findings.message: The sponsor packet does not mark tax form readiness as complete or not applicable.
findings.remediation: Resolve sponsor-side tax form readiness before prize commitments are advertised.

findings.message: Expected payout jurisdictions differ from the sponsor jurisdiction but withholding review is incomplete.
findings.remediation: Complete cross-border withholding review before challenge launch.

findings.message: The challenge is marked as regulated but lacks a regulatory review packet digest.
findings.remediation: Attach the domain-specific regulatory review packet before publishing the challenge.

findings.message: Third-party prize funding is marked but no sponsor disclosure digest is attached.
findings.remediation: Attach a disclosure digest naming the upstream funder and any restrictions on the prize.

findings.message: A restricted export-control classification lacks counsel approval evidence.
findings.remediation: Attach counsel approval and participant restrictions before publishing the challenge.

findings.message: International participation is expected but no participant-control digest is attached.
findings.remediation: Record eligibility controls for international participants before the challenge opens.

findings.message: The challenge does not have immutable public rules evidence.
findings.remediation: Attach a SHA-256 digest of the public rules, deliverables, and evaluation disclosures.
